Home.metaTitle: Web, app and online store development

hero.eyebrow: Independent software and digital product studio
hero.sub: I design, build and evolve websites, online stores, platforms and integrations for companies that need to run better, sell online or launch something new. You talk directly to the engineer who builds your project.
hero.layersLabel: The layers of a digital product

problems.title: Does any of these problems sound familiar?
problems.lead: Pick one and see how I would approach it. I talk about possible results, not promised ones: they depend on each business and are measured from the start.

services.title: Six lines of work. One standard.
services.lead: You can start with one and add others when the business calls for it. They all share the same way of working: an assessment, phases and deliveries you can review.
services.flowTitle: How a project of this kind flows

ai.title: AI applied to processes
ai.text: Assistants, information sorting or AI automations in tasks where a mistake can be spotted and corrected. Publish only if it is confirmed as a service.

cases.title: Real work, told with verifiable data.
cases.lead: For each project I show the challenge, the solution and only the results the client has confirmed. What is still missing is marked.

process.title: In phases, with deliveries you can see.
process.lead: Every phase ends with something concrete. That way you decide with information instead of promises, and you can change course before investing in the next one.
process.note: I do not publish generic timelines: each proposal sets its times according to the real scope.

criteria.title: The problem first. Then the technology.
criteria.lead: I do not start with a favorite tool. I start with what your business needs and choose the simplest option that solves it well and can be maintained.

about.role: Founder · Engineer responsible for every project
about.title: An independent studio. The person you talk to is the one who builds.
about.body: Mr. Design is not a big agency and does not pretend to be one. The person who listens to you in the first meeting is the one who designs the architecture, writes the code and answers when something needs attention.
about.bodyCollaborators: When a project needs other specialties, I work with collaborators openly and you know who is involved.
